Note: Scripts a build has made redundant. The Park Scripts button on the Dashboard reads this file, shows every entry with the recommended ones already ticked, and parks whatever is left ticked. Top it up when a new build absorbs more tools.
HowRecommendWorks: Recommend true means this tool is genuinely superseded and the entry is ticked when the window opens. Recommend false means it is offered but NOT ticked -- a judgement call the operator makes, not one this file makes for them.
